newsitem.title: USA: Innovex stake held by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Innovex stake held by Vinik group.

text.p: A group including Vinik Asset Mangement LP and former Fidelity Investments fund manager Jeffery Vinik said late Monday it held a 8.9 percent stake in Innovex Inc, or 636,200 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake between Nov 6 and Nov 15 at prices ranging from $23.8528 to $29.2956 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.

Innovex of Hopkins, Minn., develops, engineers and manufactures specialty precision electromagnetic products for original equipment manufacturers. Lead wire assemblies for the thin disk drive market are its primary product.
